description: This file contains the implementation of the application class for a Windows UWP calculator app, including initialization, launch handling, activation, and jump list setup.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Represents the application class for a UWP calculator app, handling initialization, activation, suspension, and jump list setup.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the application, sets up debugging, and registers event handlers.

methods.name: OnLaunched
methods.description: Handles the app launch event, setting up the main window and navigation.

methods.name: OnActivated
methods.description: Handles activation events, including protocol activation.

methods.name: OnAppLaunch
methods.description: Performs common setup tasks when the app is launched or activated, such as setting window size, navigation, and theme.

methods.name: OnSuspending
methods.description: Handles the app suspension event, logging button usage.

methods.name: SetupJumpListAsync
methods.description: Configures the jump list with calculator categories based on current view modes.
